description: Arms the element picker in the browser and waits for the user to click the elements they mean, then returns them with ranked selectors. Use this instead of guessing when a page has several things that match the description ("the save button", "that broken card"), or when you cannot find what the user is describing. Asking costs one turn; picking the wrong element costs the whole task.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the user. They need time to find the element.

name: await_user_selection
title: Ask the user to point at it
